findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_doctors, get_listing_by_url, get_material, search_materials, get_booking_confirm_link, get_public_share_url, list_sitemap_priorities, message_listing · Private data: get_listing_by_url, list_credentials, list_work_experience, create_booking · Public sink: get_listing_by_url, get_public_share_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_doctors, get_listing_by_url, get_material, search_materials, get_booking_confirm_link, get_public_share_url, list_sitemap_priorities, message_listing · Private data: get_listing_by_url, list_credentials, list_work_experience, create_booking · Public sink: get_listing_by_url, get_public_share_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
